turns.question: How many site sessions were there per order placed between 20 September and 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no sessions-per-order metric, so I cannot give that ratio; the closest figures are 7 site sessions and 75 orders placed, both for 20 September to 2 October 2026 (13 days, inclusive).
